caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a round, shallow, metal cauldron or pot with a slightly tapering base and three small, pointed feet. The cauldron is rendered in a dark, muted color, appearing mostly gray or black with shading that indicates its metallic texture. The pot features a simple, thin, curved handle attached symmetrically at two points on opposite sides of the rim, arching above the vessel in a near-semicircle. The drawing is centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background with no additional objects or decorative elements surrounding the cauldron. The composition is minimal with the vessel positioned upright in the middle of the page. There are faint marks and smudges around the background, and a signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Onion Kettle
